messages:
oliver-cs: FYI AcmeCorp escalation — dedicated pool didn't scale fast enough during their 00:00->00:30 ramp. Customer reported sustained 429s and generation latency up ~3-5s. They attached traces and a short repro.
sophie-support: Customer says requests queued, then started getting 429s. They have minReplicas=2 but traffic spiked to demand ~12. Warmup lag reported ~18m.
raj-eng-platform: Pinging eng-runtime — any known attach rate caps or registry pull issues overnight? Could be image pulls or auth.
autoscale-bot: probe: attach_rate_limited=TRUE, registry_pull_backoff=0.8s, attach_queue_len=312
mina-eng-runtime: I'm pulling controller logs now. Quick look: multiple scale decisions issued but attach attempts queued. Seeing transient 403s from IAM during token rotation and image pull retries piling up.
tomas-oncall: Can you paste their serving config? Also what's their headroom/canary policy?
oliver-cs: here's the snippet they shared: ```yaml
minReplicas: 2
maxReplicas: 50
headroomPercent: 10
prewarmPoolSize: 0
burstCapacity: disabled
```
sophie-support: They are on Dedicated Standard with reserved capacity but burst was disabled — they're relying solely on autoscale.
raj-eng-platform: Hypothesis: minReplicas floor + disabled burst + transient IAM auth errors -> attach throttling -> scaleup appears slow. Probe pacing might be conservative too.
mina-eng-runtime: Reproducer I'm running: 1) fire 100 concurrent probe requests, 2) watch attach queue and attach error logs. Observed logs: `AttachFailed: IAMTokenExpired` followed by exponential retries. Also many image pull backoffs.
oliver-cs: Customer's curl repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"..."}'` ramped to ~800 qps for ~3m starting 00:00.
tomas-oncall: Quick mitigations: (A) temporarily bump prewarmPoolSize to 10 for the org, (B) enable burstCapacity for 1h, (C) relax attach backoff and increase parallel image pulls on nodes, (D) verify IAM rotation config. Ops sign-off needed for quotas.
raj-eng-platform: +1 for enabling burst as emergency mitigation. I'll open the ops change and request quota bump.
sophie-support: I'll inform the customer and ask for request IDs and any additional traces. Giving an ETA for mitigations.
mina-eng-runtime: Controller patch ready to reduce probe interval 5s->2s and increase attach parallelism. Will test on staging then canary to prod.
oliver-cs: Thanks. For the postmortem please collect: attach queue histograms, image pull error rates, IAM token error counts, scale decision timestamps and probe intervals.
autoscale-bot: incident ticket created: #INC-7892 (linked).
sophie-support: Customer updated — after we enabled burst the 429 rate dropped to ~5%. They still see 1-2s extra cold latency. They'll monitor and we will follow up tomorrow.
